item.title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Like a real-life episode of Suits, the demise of famed white-shoe Wall Street law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges has been the talk of the legal industry. And now, an AI firm has entered the picture.

item.title: Satlyt takes another step toward turning satellites into space data centers
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Satlyt ran a successful test this month bringing it closer to turning spacecraft, starting with satellites, into virtual data centers.

item.title: Zest’s new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.

item.title: Skip the small talk: Make game-changing connections at TechCrunch Founder Summit with Braindate
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: At TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026, happening November 4 at SoWa Power Station in Boston, networking powered by Braindate is designed to make those conversations easier to find, whether they are in 1:1 or small-group on-site meetings. Register before the event starts to save up to $100 on your pass, plus get a second for free.

item.title: 5 days left: Your last chance to connect, scale, and save at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: 5 days to save up to $100, plus a second pass for free to TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 in Boston on November 4. Register now.

item.title: Can AI data centers be mass-produced like cars? This startup aims to find out
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Runware is building a factory to turn out prefabricated AI data centers on an assembly line. The real test will be whether it can deliver at that scale.

item.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

item.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

item.title: Who will you learn from in 6 days at TechCrunch Founder Summit? Meet the founders and investors taking the stages
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Six days from now, on November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register before it starts for ticket savings and deals.

item.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

item.title: 7 days until TechCrunch Founder Summit: Save up to $100 on your pass before doors open
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: In just 7 days, TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston’s SoWa Power Station on November 4. Your chance to save up to $100 on tickets is running out, and the opportunity to learn and connect directly with experienced founders, investors, and startup leaders is almost here.

item.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.

item.title: Guidewire buys Hyperexponential for $1.7B in cash
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The deal, expected to close sometime next year, is to help bring AI agents to work alongside humans to underwrite, analyze, and price decisions.

item.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

item.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

item.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

item.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: "It's causing a lot of people to run who I don't want to be running," native Californian Palmer Luckey said. "But I'm planning on staying in California. I'm going to keep fighting it."

item.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S., and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.
